Vessel with four Indians hit at Ukraine's Odesa port; two safe, two missing

A merchant vessel carrying four Indian nationals was struck at Ukraine's Odesa port on Saturday, July 25, 2026. Two of the four Indian crew members are confirmed safe, while the fate of the other two remains unknown. The Indian Embassy in Kyiv announced the incident and is monitoring the situation. This attack occurred days after a previous strike on a vessel in the same port.
